## Bluesky Embed Extension

This example demonstrates how to use the bsky-embed Quarto extension.

### Basic Usage

Embed a user's feed:

{{< bsky-embed username="vincentwill.com" >}}

### With Options

Embed with dark mode and custom limit:

{{< bsky-embed username="vincentwill.com" mode="dark" limit="5" >}}

### Search Posts

Search for posts with a hashtag:

{{< bsky-embed search="#BuildInPublic" limit="5" >}}

### Custom Feed

Embed a custom feed by ID:

{{< bsky-embed feed="at://did:plc:jcoy7v3a2t4rcfdh6i4kza25/app.bsky.feed.generator/astro" limit="5" >}}

### All Available Options

The shortcode supports all the same options as the web component:

- `username`: User handle
- `feed`: Feed ID
- `search`: Search term (e.g., hashtags)
- `limit`: Number of posts to display (default: 10)
- `mode`: Set to "dark" for dark mode
- `link-target`: Link target (_self, _blank, _parent, _top)
- `link-image`: Set to "true" to make images links
- `load-more`: Set to "true" to enable load more button
- `disable-styles`: Set to "true" to disable default styles
- `disable-images`: Set to "true" to disable images
- `disable-videos`: Set to "true" to disable videos
- `disable-autoplay`: Set to "true" to disable video autoplay
- `custom-styles`: Custom CSS styles
- `custom-styles-file`: URL to custom CSS file
- `date-format`: JSON string for date formatting
